method: Live official MOHRE browser cards, Arabic and English compared; paraphrased facts. Earlier capture timeouts are superseded for these four cards only.

records.notes: HOSSAM BAHR explanatory translation of the reviewed Arabic MOHRE card. The English card currently mislabels process steps as required documents and incorrectly refers to no valid residence visa; the Arabic card specifies no active work permit and a valid Golden Residence. Do not treat the English wording as an additional eligibility restriction.

The reviewed Arabic card identifies the quota as a mission-permit requirement. The English condition calls it temporary work; this guide follows the Arabic service-specific wording. Permit validity must not be confused with processing time.

records.note: Supporting evidence is conditional: if available, not a fabricated mandatory document set.
